title: session-detail-result query_result
description: Validated after correlation with the v1 query in the common request envelope. provider_metadata and provider_runtime are seams: opaque provider documents whose shape the contract never models, so a second provider may report entirely different documents without a schema change. Both are optional, because a provider that reports neither is honest about it and the surface renders the absence as not reported. The contract bounds their size only, and a document that exceeds the bound is rejected rather than truncated.
